policy.qualification: Deterministic core invariants; seconds-scale and safe to run before any campaign work.
policy.normal: Ordinary package and contract tests selected by the central pytest tier policy.
policy.integration: External services, installed tools, or cross-process boundaries; unavailable dependencies remain unavailable or skipped.
policy.expensive: Long campaigns, large corpora, or resource-heavy historical checks.
policy.certification: The complete collection used for freeze, portability, and release certification.

tiers.name: normal
tiers.selector: normal and not integration and not expensive and not certification

tiers.name: integration
tiers.writes: temporary or explicitly configured external test state

tiers.name: expensive
tiers.writes: temporary test state and declared local runtime output

tiers.name: certification
dependencies: all dependencies required by the selected checks
tiers.writes: only declared test/runtime output; no scientific authority is silently regenerated
